errors.description: Model incorrectly identified the top-face color of cubes at key timestamps. For example, at 0:13 (Roll 2), it claims Cube 1 is blue, but ground truth shows Cube 1 is blue only at Roll 2 — which the model misassigned as Roll 1. This cascades into miscounting green occurrences.

analysis_result.analysis: The model’s core failure stems from misinterpreting the temporal sequence of rolls. It treated the state at 0:13 as the result of the first roll, whereas the ground truth timeline clearly marks Roll 1 as completed at 0:11. This initial misalignment caused cascading errors in assigning top-face colors to the wrong roll numbers. Consequently, the model recorded green appearances in incorrect rolls, leading to an inflated total of 7 instead of the correct 5. While the model’s arithmetic and counting logic were internally consistent, they were applied to a fundamentally misaligned perception of events, making the error severe and systemic.
